Branch: `372-bound-axis-assertions`; clean starting head `60c5225fe5f93209bf313c51b7a722f25f9aaa7d`, tree `64182178131d03f157fe1a4ec767edee618bc6ff`.
Authoritative references: [correction assignment](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/372#issuecomment-5780262565), [settled contract](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/372#issuecomment-5776353888), REQUIREMENTS REQ-VER-01/02/04, CONTRIBUTING, [R239-1 F1/F2/F3](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/518#issuecomment-5779875386), [round completion and updated immutable evidence](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/518#issuecomment-5779875726), R240-1 and replica cleanup.
Interpreted scope: correct only R239 F1/F2/F3, all MINOR Docs, in `docs/testing/ASSERTIONS.md`, `docs/testing/TESTING.md`, `tb/verilator/README.md` and the header comment of `tb/verilator/ptp_ts/mux_sva_main.cpp`. Document pinned 5.050 reset/vacuity and first-past measurements, the 15 equality / 2 floor / 4 presence witness checks, and the untested formal boundary. Preserve every executable harness byte after the header and all other executable artifacts; optional suggestions remain in #495.
Validation plan: verify text against unchanged immutable R239 probe sources/logs and `grade_witnesses()`; record exact attribution/hashes. Run `docs_check.py`, `gen_toc.py --check`/`--verify-anchors`, `check_em_dash.py --base`, doc style/path, idiom and hygiene gates; prove only the four allowed paths changed and the harness executable suffix is byte-identical. Any focused width-8/64 runs use only the supplied pinned 5.050 selector and at most eight build jobs. Commit locally with factual command/head/tree/exit receipts and handoff; no push or PR metadata change.
Blockers: none for this bounded correction. R240 internal Codex and R239 external Opus retain corrected-source review ownership; Opus availability is pending. Tests/Robustness need corrected-head coverage because the harness artifact changes. Manager full validation/publication/act/hosted and all completion duties remain pending; no author approval or waiver.
